promptPolicy: Prompts are written the way an ordinary user writes them. No template contains an instruction to sound human, avoid detection, vary sentence length, or lower perplexity. Adversarial and humanizer-processed text is a separate corpus and is out of scope for this cycle — the question here is whether a detector catches AI text that nobody tried to hide.
resolution: Placeholders are resolved by data/cycles/<cycle>/select-placeholders.js from the cycle nonce, which is committed as a SHA-256 hash before any prompt is generated and revealed at cycle close. See docs/VERIFICATION.md.
